annotations.text:
Task 14 gate: sign off before any UI code (Tasks 15-28).
Direction: native macOS 15 chrome (SF Pro, source-list sidebar) around true terminal grounds (#191A22). No light/dark modes: THEMES, mirroring herdr built-ins (17 palettes: tokyo-night default, tokyo-night-day, catppuccin, solarized, nord, gruvbox, rose-pine, kanagawa, one-dark, dracula, vesper + light variants). The two windows show Tokyo Night and Tokyo Night Day; chrome tokens and status colors all derive from the active theme palette. Terminal cells always render the terminal own theme.
Agent status mirrors YOUR herdr header (Tokyo Night via theme=terminal): working amber #E0AF68, blocked red #F7768E, done teal #7DCFFF, idle green #9ECE6A, unknown #565F89. Zoom badge is mauve so it never reads as a status.
Terminal text and pane titles are illustrative; layout, chrome, spacing, states and colors are the real proposal.

Added at review: attention toasts (click jumps to the pane), copy-on-selection parity, right-click routing (herdr 0.9 pane.input.set) with the Option+click gesture reserved for the v1.5 input channel. See the Notifications & pointer sheet.
